name: Something went wrong page
summary: A 500 page that says the problem is on our side, that the person's work is safe, and gives a retry and a reference code for support.
use: when the server or a service fails and the page can't load
a11y: A polite status line under the buttons says when a retry starts, how it ended and when the code is copied; the reference code is plain text people can select.

use_when: the server returned an error page could not recover from
avoid_when: one part of the page failed: show an error banner in that part (page-banners)
there is no connection: use page-offline
keyboard: Tab reaches Copy code, Try again and Contact support
Enter or Space presses a button; focus stays on Try again while it retries

empty.how: Not applicable: this state screen shows no list of records.

loading.how: Try again shows a spinner and is aria-disabled while it retries.

error.how: The part is itself an error or system state, written in plain words with a next step.

disabled.how: Try again is aria-disabled during a retry, so it can't be pressed twice.

overflow.how: Actions stack full width under 30rem; the panel caps its width.

long_text.how: Titles balance and body text wraps at word boundaries inside a capped measure.

missing_image.how: The part has no picture; its drawing is an inline icon.
